description: Haffner was identified as a potential 2027 Two Thousand Guineas Stakes (G1) and Prix du Jockey Club (French Derby, G1) contender by Aidan O'Brien after landing the Acomb Stakes (G3) impressively under Ryan Moore Aug. 19 at York Racecourse.

title_en: Minnie Hauk Bids to Defend Yorkshire Oaks Crown
description: You have to rewind to Islington in 2003 to find the last filly to go back-to-back in the Yorkshire Oaks (G1). But Minnie Hauk is back Aug. 20 to defend the crown she won so decisively last year at York Racecourse.

title_en: Brown Seeks Ninth Ballston Spa With Segesta, Grayosh
description: Trainer Chad Brown seeks a ninth victory in the $300,000 Ballston Spa Stakes (G2T) Aug. 22 at Saratoga Race Course, with dual grade 1 winner Segesta and multiple graded winner Grayosh carrying the barn's banner.

title_en: Item Gets Up Late to Win International Stakes
description: Item overcomes all kinds of trouble to snatch victory on the line from Almaqam in an International Stakes (G1) Aug 19 at York Racecourse that departed dramatically from the script.

title_en: Road to Del Mar Oaks Leads Down Kensington Lane
description: Belmont Oaks (G1T) winner Kensington Lane heads an international field of 3-year-old fillies taking dead aim on the $300,000 Del Mar Oaks (G1T) as part of the Aug. 22 Pacific Classic program.

title_en: Sam Houston to Open in December; Adds Stakes
description: For the first time in 17 years, Thoroughbred racing will be held at Sam Houston Race Park in the month of December, as the season will kick off Dec. 18. Closing day of the Thoroughbred season will be April 3.

title_en: Rivera Jr.'s Iselin Win Lands Jockey of the Week Honors
description: Luis Rivera Jr. made the most of his opportunity in the Philip H. Iselin Stakes (G3) at Monmouth Park. Riding the 6-year-old Bishops Bay for the first time, Rivera earned the first graded stakes victory of his riding career.

title_en: Luster Shines Light on Sire Knicks Go
description: In this week's Porter on Pedigrees, Luster, who rolled to victory in the Aug. 15 King's Plate Stakes at Woodbine, is from the first crop of 2021 Horse of the Year and champion older dirt male Knicks Go.

title_en: Podcast Playback: Quotes of Interest From Aug. 12-18
description: Quotes of interest include NTRA's Tom Rooney on the SAFE Act; trainer Josie Carroll on King's Plate Stakes winner Luster; and owner, handicapper Bob Hansen on computer-assisted wagering.

title_en: Mullins Joins Heavyweights at Arqana August Sale
description: Willie Mullins has never been afraid to break new ground in pursuit of winners, as he proved when joining flat superpowers such as Coolmore, Godolphin, and Juddmonte on the buying bench at the Arqana August Yearling Sale.

title_en: Motorious Bids for Fourth Consecutive Green Flash Win
description: Motorious isn't in the same Del Mar class as Gold Phoenix, a record-setting winner of six stakes at the seaside track, but he is doing his best to emulate him. He goes for a fourth consecutive victory in the Aug. 22 Green Flash Handicap (G2T) there.

title_en: Pacific Classic a Highlight on Week's Radio/TV Schedule

description: A yearling by Cyberknife and a pair of horses of racing age, including a winning 3-year-old, have been added to the 2026 Texas Summer Yearling Sale catalog.

title_en: Mansfield Racing Dispersal Added to LA Yearling Sale
description: Breeders Sales of Louisiana announces the addition of Mansfield Racing dispersal as a supplement to the Preferred Yearling Sale to be held Sept. 1 in Opelousas, La.

title_en: Juveniles Inshallah, Q B Rocket Run to Lofty Price Tags
description: Juveniles Inshallah and Q B Rocket—who cost a combined $4 million at auction—are BloodHorse Maiden Watch Hot Prospects after delivering on expectations with first-out victories Aug. 15.

title_en: Sovereignty, Nitrogen Remain Atop NTRA Poll
description: No changes occurred in the Top 10 of the National Thoroughbred Racing Association's Top Thoroughbred Poll released Aug. 18, but weekend winners Survie and Luster gained enough support to appear in the top 20.

description: Wagering on The King's Plate race Aug. 15 at Woodbine reached $4,202,181, a 4.5% increase over 2025. The $1,242,081 win pool was the largest in King's Plate history, surpassing the previous record set in 2023.

title_en: Ombudsman, Constitution River Set for Clash at York
description: Ombudsman heads nine declared runners for the Aug. 19 International Stakes (G1), with an eagerly awaited dust-up with Constitution River confirmed for the opening day of York's Ebor festival.

description: On the Aug. 17 episode of BloodHorse Monday: Josie Carroll discusses Luster's dominant King's Plate score, we debate whether Journalism and White Abarrio should be in the Hall of Fame, and reaction to HISA's actions against Marshall Gramm.

title_en: Adios Jojo Takes Longacres Mile Over Touchy Via DQ
description: After a thrilling and elongated stretch run, Touchy prevailed by a nose over 32-1 upstart Adios Jojo in the $125,000 Longacres Mile Aug. 16 at Emerald Downs, but was disqualified for interference in the stretch.

title_en: Sweet Azteca Nails Rancho Bernardo Stakes Three-Peat
description: Sweet Azteca won a pace duel with the speedy Thermal to take the Rancho Bernardo Stakes at Del Mar for the third straight year. Juan Hernandez was aboard the 6-year-old daughter of Sharp Azteca for trainer Richard Baltas.

title_en: Survie Says: It Pays to Ship to Saratoga
description: Michael Tabor's Survie earned a unique double by capturing two graded stakes at Saratoga Race Course just 13 days apart, completing the task with a flying finish Aug. 15 in the $750,000 Christophe Clement Turf (G1T).

title_en: Stradale Outlasts Oscar's Hope to Take Mahony
description: The two horses with the least experience on grass were the top two across the Saratoga Race Course wire Aug. 16 in the $225,000 Mahony Stakes (G3T), with Stradale outlasting Oscar's Hope to win by a neck.

title_en: Rice Bidding for Another Spa Title After Five-Win Day
description: It may be August with summer temperatures in the Adirondack Mountains, but it was the Big A at Saratoga Race Course on Aug. 15 to Linda Rice, who duplicated her wintertime feat at the Big A by winning five races at Saratoga.

title_en: Imagination to Stand at Mountain View Farm in 2027
description: Mountain View Farm announced Aug. 15 that multiple grade 2 winner and grade 1 performer Imagination will enter stud at the Gansevoort, N.Y., farm for the 2027 breeding season. He is expected to race twice more this year.

title_en: Modonday First Winner for Freshman Sire Mo Donegal
description: Modonday was an emphatic first winner for sire Mo Donegal, running out a 7 1/2-length winner on debut in a maiden special weight race Aug. 15 at Gulfstream Park.

title_en: Profiles of TOBA's Winning Breeders of 2025
description: The Thoroughbred Owners and Breeders Association will celebrate state and Canadian winners at a Sept. 11 luncheon at Coolmore's Ashford Stud near Versailles, Ky.

title_en: Deterministic to Stand at Lane's End Upon Retirement
description: Four-time grade 1-winning turf horse Deterministic will enter stud at Lane's End in Kentucky following the conclusion of his racing career.

title_en: Explora Loves to Sprint, Her Family is Rich in Stamina
description: In this week's Porter on Pedigrees, Explora is victorious in back-to-back races for the first time after winning the Test Stakes at Saratoga Race Course. She is best as a sprinter, an aptitude that defies what appears to be a stamina-laden pedigree.

title_en: Elloree Training Center's Franklin Smith Sr. Dies at 82
description: Franklin Smith Sr. founded the Elloree Training Center in 1976, developing a nationally renowned site for breaking and training young Thoroughbreds. He also ran a small breeding operation at the center.

title_en: TOBA Announces 2025 State Breeder of the Year Awards
description: The Thoroughbred Owners and Breeders Association announced Aug. 11 the recipients of the 2025 State and Canadian Breeder of the Year Awards, recognizing outstanding breeders whose achievements distinguished them during the 2025 racing season.

title_en: Midnight Skull Initial Winner for Warrior's Charge
description: Midnight Skull becomes the first winner for freshman sire Warrior's Charge in taking a maiden special weight contest on debut Aug. 9 at Camarero Race Track in Puerto Rico.
